name: io.github.nightmoose/contractgate
title: DataContractGate and AISchemaGate
description: MCP server for DataContractGate and AISchemaGate. DataContractGate validates events at ingest against semantic data contracts (ODCS v3.1 and v3.2), masks PII, and quarantines failures for replay. AISchemaGate validates LLM structured output at runtime through egress_validate, with violation-fed auto-repair.

environmentVariables.name: CONTRACTGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DataContractGate or AISchemaGate API key (cg_live_...). Create one at https://app.datacontractgate.com/account

environmentVariables.name: CONTRACTGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://api.datacontractgate.com
